response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM t), k1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.a FROM t, b1 WHERE t.a > b1.v), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM k1), f AS (SELECT k1.a, b1.v AS v1, b2.v AS v2 FROM k1, b1, b2 WHERE k1.a > b2.v) SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(a - v1) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(a - v2) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM f
